vision.policy: Run Apple Vision on all initial frames. Send only Apple NO_PERSON frames to Codex in contact sheets of at most four, with at most four independent sheets in flight. Refine only strata that Codex still labels NO_PERSON, then run Apple on every refinement frame and send only refinement NO_PERSON frames to Codex. Never load or call Qwen.

asr.policy: Windowed local ASR/VAD generates execution-time cut-coordinate suggestions only; it is not a semantic or final-quality audit layer. No full-media retranscription by default.
